skill.name: fit-scorer
skill.description: Scores shortlisted influencers with the typed C3 ACE rubric and ranks campaign-specific commercial fit separately. It does not discover creators or send outreach.
skill.summary: Score shortlisted creators with evidence-backed ACE results and a separate campaign-fit ranking.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most findings are scanner false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code, and relative documentation links. The skill explicitly runs local Python tooling, uses shell command substitution, and expects a YouTube API key. No prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Bundle and pin the scripts, validate creator handles as arguments, and require confirmation before running commands.
Replace git-based root discovery with a validated installation root and reject script paths outside the trusted package.

remediation.issue: API key access by the connector
remediation.suggestion: Document minimum key scope, expose YOUTUBE_API_KEY only during connector execution, and never print or persist the value.

content.value_statement: Creator shortlists are difficult to compare consistently across audience, credibility, engagement, and campaign needs. This skill applies typed ACE scoring and separates commercial fit.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates all 12 Audience, Credibility, and Engagement items with typed evidence states.
Preserves evidence dates, confidence, cohort context, profile version, and scoring coverage.
Runs the deterministic repository scorer when its runtime and typed catalog are available.
Builds a separate commercial-fit matrix across audience, content, brand, terms, availability, and partnership potential.
Ranks shortlisted creators while showing critical controls, evidence gaps, and outreach recommendations.
limitations: Requires a creator shortlist and current campaign context from the user.
Cannot produce a complete ACE total when required evidence remains Unknown.
Deterministic scoring depends on repository scripts and catalogs that may be absent from standalone installs.
Does not discover new creators, negotiate terms, or send outreach.

use_cases.title: Prioritize a Campaign Shortlist
use_cases.description: Compare shortlisted creators under one campaign goal and identify evidence-backed outreach priorities.

use_cases.title: Standardize Client Recommendations
use_cases.description: Apply one typed rubric across creators while keeping client-specific commercial fit separate.

use_cases.title: Audit Creator Evidence
use_cases.description: Review credibility vetoes, missing metrics, and confidence before approving a partnership.

prompt_templates.title: Score One Creator
prompt_templates.prompt: Score @[handle] for [campaign]. Use goal [goal] and list the evidence needed before making a recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare a Shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare @[handle1], @[handle2], and @[handle3] for [campaign]. Show ACE results separately from commercial fit.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Evidence Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these creator metrics for [campaign]. Mark missing data Unknown, identify critical controls, and explain what prevents a final score.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Advanced Ranking
prompt_templates.prompt: Rank [creators] for [campaign] using [goal]. Include typed context, dated evidence, veto checks, commercial terms, confidence, and rerun conditions.

output_examples.input: Compare three sustainable fashion creators for a conversion campaign.
output: Creator A leads commercial fit because audience overlap and availability are strongest.
Creator B has an ACE veto from verified inauthentic engagement.
Creator C remains provisional because audience authenticity is Unknown.

output_examples.input: Score one YouTube creator with incomplete audience data.
output: ACE coverage is incomplete, so no final total is issued.
Available engagement evidence is dated and labeled Measured.
The report requests audience authenticity data before outreach.

best_practices: Use the same evidence window, cohort, and campaign goal for every compared creator.
Keep ACE results separate from campaign-specific commercial-fit scores.
Verify critical failures and refresh stale metrics before approving outreach.
anti_patterns: Do not treat missing or refused private data as a failure.
Do not hand-calculate an ACE total when the deterministic scorer is unavailable.
Do not let commercial fit override an ACE veto or unresolved evidence gap.

faq.question: Does this skill find influencers?
faq.answer: No. It scores a supplied shortlist. Use an influencer discovery workflow to source additional candidates.

faq.question: What is the ACE rubric?
faq.answer: ACE evaluates creator Audience, Credibility, and Engagement through 12 typed items and defined critical controls.

faq.question: Can it score creators without integrations?
faq.answer: Yes. Users can provide the required metrics, but missing evidence remains Unknown and may prevent a final total.

faq.question: Does brand fit change the ACE score?
faq.answer: No. Brand and campaign fit belong in a separate commercial matrix and never enter the ACE result.

faq.question: Can it compare creators across platforms?
faq.answer: Yes, when each creator has clear platform, tier, niche, cohort, and evidence context.

faq.question: Does it save reports automatically?
faq.answer: No. It should persist reports only after explicit user authorization.
